title: Count War
description: Count the armies and win every battle! A fun counting and math game for kids.

title: Rail Rush
description: Run along the tracks, dodge trains and collect coins! Swipe to change lanes, jump and slide.

title: Cycle Run
description: Ride your bicycle, jump over obstacles, duck under birds and collect coins! Tap to jump, swipe down to duck.

title: Super Jumper
description: Super Jumper to play online , free game for kids.

title: Neon Snake
description: Guide the glowing snake, eat the neon food and grow longer without hitting the walls or yourself. Use arrow keys, WASD or swipe on mobile. The faster you grow, the faster you go!
